content:
Hi all — we’d like to share a new VS Code extension for assisting Lean 4 proof development: Mozi Lean Copilot.

Mozi is built by the PKU AI4Math team in collaboration with IQuest Research. It runs on top of your current Lean project to support proof writing in an interactive manner: filling sorrys, iteratively repairing errors guided by Lean compiler feedback.

Feature

Prover Agent workflow: Mozi is driven by a workflow with a generate → verify → feedback loop. It collaborates with you in VS Code to fill proof gaps, localize errors, and iteratively propose fixes. Advanced mode integrates latest LeanSearch to retrieve relevant lemmas from mathlib (network required).

Native VS Code experience: Built on GitHub Copilot Chat, Mozi fits into your existing Lean project with zero migration. No special project structure or Lean version migration required — just use it where you already edit proofs.

Availability: Mozi is currently in beta testing and distributed as VSIX package. Please register in the following form to get quick access.

Registration: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/dWhvC1NdhX
Demo: Mozi Lean Copilot Demo
